title: Staging Recovery B2A Remote MCP runtime schema repair

phases.objective: Restore the four canonical Remote MCP runtime foundation tables when an existing non-empty local Staging Runtime schema omitted them, using only the repository-owned exact-SHA schema-repair authority and same-cycle readback.

e2e_journeys.actor: Local Windows Staging recovery operator through the governed Recovery System surface
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: staging_recovery_schema_repair_prepare on the exact deployed main SHA with the repository-owned corrective migration.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The corrective migration is allowlisted, checksum-bound, approval-gated, ticket-bound and read back through declared schema postconditions; Production and provider mutation remain forbidden.
steps: Bind the repair to the exact current main deployment and Staging target fingerprint.
Resolve only 20261003_staging_remote_mcp_runtime_foundation_reconciliation.sql from the repository-owned Staging schema-repair allowlist.
Create platform_runtime_config and the three Remote MCP OAuth persistence tables with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS only.
Require the exact typed confirmation APPLY_STAGING_RUNTIME_MIGRATION:<sha>:staging-runtime:<migration> before issuing the single-use execution ticket.
Verify key columns and indexes for all four tables in the same execution cycle.
Run the separately governed Staging readiness/grant repair only after schema postconditions are ready.
Do not enable OAuth, provision clients, mutate provider state, sign Recovery acquisition evidence, run the Recovery canary, or mutate Production as part of this migration.
assertions: The migration contains four additive CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statements and no INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, ALTER, GRANT or REVOKE statement.
The migration targets the runtime role only and accepts only dry_run and apply_migration.
Schema repair remains server-derived; caller raw SQL, caller database selection and caller commands are forbidden.
Same-cycle postconditions cover platform_runtime_config plus remote_mcp_oauth_clients, remote_mcp_oauth_authorization_codes and remote_mcp_oauth_grants.
The migration itself grants no database privileges; access reconciliation remains a separate governed operation.
Production mutation, Hostinger mutation, provider mutation and external evidence fabrication remain false.
The declaration is registered exactly in Constitution.control_plane_paths and convergence.automation_control_paths.

phases.objective: Production schema mutation and release promotion remain outside this Staging corrective repair.
blockers: Production requires a separate governed promotion and Production-authorized migration lifecycle.
This declaration grants no Production database, Hostinger, provider or deployment mutation authority.
